context: The agent was asked to deduplicate vulnerability scan findings and prioritize remediation. CVE-2024-1234 appears in two packages (libssl3 and libcrypto3) but is one vulnerability. Critical and high-severity findings must not be omitted.

checklist.name: deduplicates_correctly
checklist.description: Correctly identifies that CVE-2024-1234 is one vulnerability affecting two packages, not two vulnerabilities

checklist.name: counts_distinct_cves
checklist.description: Reports the correct count of distinct CVEs (4 distinct CVEs across all findings)

checklist.name: prioritizes_by_severity_and_fix
checklist.description: Correctly identifies high/critical findings with fixes (CVE-2024-1234, CVE-2024-3456, CVE-2024-7890) as top priority

checklist.name: flags_no_fix_available
checklist.description: Identifies CVE-2024-9012 as having no fix available and requiring mitigation or risk acceptance

checklist.name: no_critical_finding_lost
checklist.description: Does NOT omit any critical or high-severity finding in the summary

checklist.name: evidence_quality
checklist.description: Cites real CVE IDs and package names from the provided scan results, no fabricated findings

checklist.name: scope_honesty
checklist.description: States what was omitted or truncated in the prioritization
